name: wrong_direction_01
notes: Two synchronized CAVIAR OneLeaveShopReenter1 views. Camera-specific image axes encode the same site-level permitted direction; the deterministic rule projects cumulative displacement from zone entry onto the normalized axis and fires for sufficiently negative movement. It is a transparent geometric rule over YOLO11+ByteTrack trajectories, not a learned action classifier. Dataset: EC-funded CAVIAR project IST 2001 37540, CC BY-SA.
